zero_default_branches.judgment: Default p0=0 adds only finite scalar input validation. Old settings, load_only start0, ordered_cycle start0/unload/end-before-peak constraints, supports, lift/shape and callbacks remain.

At p0=0, expected warm lift is lift_origin.copy(), preserving the old bitwise comparison including signed zero. Cold state, fluctuation, R, state_s=0 and K=None match the prior branch; no display or algebra rebase is introduced.

Initial p0=0 leaves the nonzero strict-anchor guard inactive. Existing parameter-zero warm state still follows normal Newton/corrector semantics, including wrong-R checking and arbitrary nonzero lift_origin/target_origin cases; it is not accidentally changed to validate-only.

p0=0 still emits origin/loading/unloading and no initial_parameter result key. Advance/line-search/bisection/cache commitment AST are unchanged. Timings and provenance bytes are not promised equal after integration.

Without saved_result, valid old explicit settings remain required, None options resolve complete/full/tangent, declared task target equality is retained, no anchor reader/defaults run, and source_hashes retain the four old key labels.

Force/tangent selector, three-component assembly, full unsymmetrized CSC cache, state-hash capture, data copies/read-only arrays, workpiece observations and cached writer AST remain; saved-index annotations and continuation metadata are inactive for zero-start.

explicit_interface_changes_not_numerical: native_mean settings keyword is now optional syntactically to enable restoration. A missing zero-start setting is rejected by TMCError invalid_settings rather than Python missing-keyword TypeError.
Explicit None options now request defaults, whereas old native_mean rejected None modes; omitted options still resolve to the same old complete/full/tangent values.

Source-file SHA fields and saved result descriptor hashes necessarily change for new runs after installation. This is correct new provenance; do not promise byte-identical whole result JSON or rewrite historical identities.

mathematical_and_cache_contract.residual: r = fint + kout*bout*qout - bin*R, with qout from compensated split measurement.
mathematical_and_cache_contract.augmented_system: [[Kff+kout*bout_f*bout_f^T, -bin_f], [bin_f^T,0]] [dw,dR] = [rhs_force,rhs_mean]; general sparse LU, no symmetry enforcement.
mathematical_and_cache_contract.predictor: rhs_force = -(K*DeltaL+kout*bout*Deltaqout)_free; rhs_mean is negative compensated current split mean minus target_origin and absolute s. port_projection substitutes only displacement seed, while predictor dR remains applied with its original sign.
mathematical_and_cache_contract.corrector: rhs_force=-r_free, rhs_mean=-constraint residual; R is signed actuator_on_model multiplier and is neither clipped nor inverted on descent.
mathematical_and_cache_contract.saved_anchor: Nonzero p0 requires ordered_cycle, mandatory saved state and first target=p0. Expected lift uses original binary64 impose expression. Initial K=None; fresh F/T must pass original residual/mean/J gates, or initial_state_not_equilibrated occurs before correction/commit. The one guard is the only AST change within Newton.
mathematical_and_cache_contract.rollback: Original advance preserves state arrays/R/s/committed-K on unaccepted Newton attempts. Capture holds independent immutable arrays/tangent/matrix copies matched by state hash. Later trial last_tangent does not overwrite prior durable accepted snapshot. Post-accept callbacks/time can already have committed observations.
mathematical_and_cache_contract.reader: Exact full original task/suffix, geometry/model/grid/material/BC/counts and saved settings/options except time; selected original accepted nonzero row and split archive identities. It reuses no old force/tangent/CSC and checks the two unchanged mechanics-kernel source SHA before fresh evaluation.
mathematical_and_cache_contract.source_limits: Public reader deliberately supports original zero-lift ordered-cycle parents only, original target rows with at least one remaining target, exact full-task suffix. It does not support another continuation child, arbitrary target extension, an inserted bisection anchor, load_only saved resume, load control or movable-body contact.
